newsitem.title: USA: Torchmark seeks approval for share increase.
newsitem.headline: Torchmark seeks approval for share increase.

text.p: Torchmark Corp said Monday it will hold a special shareholders' meeting on June 23, to vote on increasing the amount of the company's total authorized common stock, which would clear the way for a two-for-one split.
Torchmark said if the increase were approved, directors would likely declare a 100 percent dividend on the common stock to be paid on August 1, 1997 to holders of record on July 1, 1997.

Directors also said if the stock dividend wereeffected, beginning with the fourth quarter of 1997, the cash dividend per common share will be adjusted to $0.145 quarterly. The company now pays a regular quarterly dividend of $0.29 per share.
